sourceWindows: OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://mentalgroove.bandcamp.com/album/planetary-invazion-ep — all four tracks on Super Nova's 1996 Planetary Invazion EP, reissued in 2018, were screened. Alien Abduction retained because the official exact-track note describes dub-infused electro turning into techno through minimal but inventive drum programming and an evolving dub-techno stab.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://ra.co/reviews/34691 — the four tracks on Lag's 2022 Frka Frka release were screened. The title track retained because Resident Advisor's exact-track review describes a jittery broken beat and an ascending progression that grows increasingly maniacal.

CURRENT / EMERGING / ADJACENT: https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-electronic/the-best-electronic-music-on-bandcamp-july-2026 and https://graca.bandcamp.com/album/nzenza — all four tracks on GRCA.'s 2026-06-26 nzenza. EP were screened. AIRPLANE MODE retained because the exact-track account identifies jittery early-grime touches inside the release's rolling polymetric batida framework.

CURRENT / EMERGING: https://opiumtrax.bandcamp.com/album/brain-destroyer and https://www.beatport.com/track/breaking-point-memories/28849428 — all four tracks on Leonardo (IT)'s 2026-05-19 BRAIN DESTROYER EP were screened. Breaking Point Memories retained because the official release note names it specifically as the breakbeat-territory cut; Beatport separately lists 89 BPM and 2:51.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: HVL's 14-track 2026 Formation, Obeka's 14-track 2026 A World No More Remixed and Molecular's ten-track 2026 Polar Shift compilation were screened. Their release-level rhythm descriptions were useful for watches and set directions but weaker than the four retained exact-track cases for this finite request.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 54 named tracks across seven current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked release/review windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. The Run 53–58 RA, Seismic, Soma, Sublunar, 30D, No.Identity, Aedi, Evod, Echoveil, Molecular, Livity Sound and Timedance discovery lanes were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

No lead was promoted for recency, label reputation, geography, genre, novelty, structural cleverness or BPM. Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Super Nova — Alien Abduction: strongest overlooked exact-track structural transformation, explicitly moving from dub-infused electro into techno.
2. Lag — Frka Frka: strongest overlooked broken-beat build, with exact-track evidence of escalating rhythmic tension.
3. GRCA. — AIRPLANE MODE: strongest current different-world lead, joining jittery grime signifiers to a documented rolling polymetric framework.
4. Leonardo (IT) — Breaking Point Memories: strongest current emerging breakbeat detour, concise and exact-track-specific but supported by less descriptive evidence.
